de.hook:
[ZWEI FORSCHER] FANDEN HERAUS: WER [1 DOLLAR]
BEKAM, FAND EINE [LANGWEILIGE] AUFGABE BESSER
ALS WER [20 DOLLAR] BEKAM.
DABEI [LOGEN] BEIDE GRUPPEN GLEICH.
de.body:
[EINE STUNDE] STUPIDE ARBEIT. DANN SOLLTEN SIE
DER NÄCHSTEN PERSON SAGEN: [WAR SPASS].

BEI [20 DOLLAR] HATTE DAS EINEN GRUND.
BEI [1 DOLLAR] KAUM. ALSO RÜCKTE DIE [MEINUNG]
NACH. SO SENKT MAN [DISSONANZ].

en.hook:
[2 RESEARCHERS] FOUND: PEOPLE PAID [$1]
RATED A [BORING] TASK HIGHER THAN
PEOPLE PAID [$20].
BOTH GROUPS SAID THE [SAME THING].
en.body:
[AN HOUR] OF MIND-NUMBING WORK. THEN THEY
TOLD THE NEXT PERSON: [IT WAS FUN].

FOR [$20] THAT HAD A REASON. FOR [$1] HARDLY.
SO THEIR [OPINION] MOVED. THAT'S
[COGNITIVE DISSONANCE].
